_note: Chapter 05 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: All the students climbed aboard the ferry with their backpacks on.
ex.cn: 所有学生都背着背包登上了渡船。
ex.note: aboard a bus/train/ship 登上…；be aboard 在…上

ex.en: He opened a bank account and checked the balance every month.
ex.cn: 他开了一个银行账户，每月都查余额。
ex.note: on account 挂账；an account of … …的记述

ex.en: The teacher was asked to account for the sudden rise in failures.
ex.cn: 老师被要求解释不及格人数骤增的原因。
ex.note: account for 解释；占（比例）

ex.en: We added a few additional details to the report before the meeting.
ex.cn: 开会前，我们又给报告补上了几处细节。
ex.note: additional information 补充信息；an additional fee 额外费用

ex.en: Afterwards we walked back to the hotel along the river.
ex.cn: 后来我们沿着河边走回了旅馆。
ex.note: afterwards = afterward，英美拼写不同；soon afterwards 不久之后

ex.en: They walked along the cliff path, with the sea on their left.
ex.cn: 他们沿着悬崖小路走，左手边是海。
ex.note: along the road 沿着这条路；along the coast 沿海

ex.en: Come along with us if you are free this afternoon.
ex.cn: 今天下午有空就一起来吧。
ex.note: come along 跟着来；get along with 与…相处

ex.en: He packed a sandwich and an apple for the long walk.
ex.cn: 他为这段长途步行装了三明治和一个苹果。
ex.note: 连接并列成分；与另一连词连用构成 not … but … 等结构

ex.en: He wrote a short apology to the teacher and returned the book.
ex.cn: 他给老师写了封简短的道歉信，把书还了回去。
ex.note: make/offer an apology 道歉；an apology for … 对…的歉意

ex.en: Difficulties arise when you try to do too much at once.
ex.cn: 想一口气做太多事情，麻烦就来了。
ex.note: arise from 由…引起；arise 是不及物动词，不能加宾语

ex.en: Two volunteers assisted the doctor with the registration.
ex.cn: 两名志愿者协助医生做登记工作。
ex.note: assist sb. with/in sth. 协助某人做某事

ex.en: The new term begins in late August, right after the summer vacation.
ex.cn: 新学期在八月下旬开学，正好接着暑假。
ex.note: in late August 在八月下旬；August 前面用介词 in

ex.en: We bought a loaf of fresh bread from the bakery around the corner.
ex.cn: 我们从街角的面包店买了一条新鲜面包。
ex.note: a bakery 一家面包店；the baker's 面包店

ex.en: A bat flew across the ceiling of the old library.
ex.cn: 一只蝙蝠从旧图书馆的天花板上飞过。
ex.note: a cricket bat 板球球拍；a badminton bat 羽毛球拍

ex.en: The children behaved very well during the ceremony.
ex.cn: 仪式期间孩子们表现得非常好。
ex.note: behave oneself 规矩点；the machine behaves well 机器运转良好

ex.en: The museum binds old manuscripts with soft cloth.
ex.cn: 博物馆用软布仔细装订古籍。
ex.note: bind sth. together 把…捆绑/装订在一起；be bound to 一定会

ex.en: He boasted that he had never missed a single lecture.
ex.cn: 他吹嘘说自己从没缺过一节课。
ex.note: boast about/of … 夸耀…；a village with a rich history 常作人名

ex.en: Two boys were playing tennis on the cracked court.
ex.cn: 两个男孩在龟裂的球场上打网球。
ex.note: a little boy 小男孩；boys and girls 男孩女孩

ex.en: Bubbles rose slowly through the clear water.
ex.cn: 气泡在清澈的水里缓缓升起。
ex.note: a bubble of joy 一阵喜悦；soap bubbles 肥皂泡

ex.en: The soup began to bubble as she added the vegetables.
ex.cn: 她把蔬菜下锅后，汤开始咕嘟冒泡。
ex.note: bubble up 冒泡；boiling 沸腾

ex.en: We had lunch in the cafeteria across the street.
ex.cn: 我们在街对面的自助餐厅吃了午饭。
ex.note: the school cafeteria 学校食堂；a cafeteria lunch 自助午餐

ex.en: She took great care to arrive before the guests did.
ex.cn: 她很用心，抢在客人之前到了。
ex.note: take care of 照顾；with care 小心地

ex.en: He cared more about the price than about the quality.
ex.cn: 他更在意价钱，而不是质量。
ex.note: care about 关心、在意；care for 照顾、喜欢

ex.en: The room had a low ceiling and warm yellow walls.
ex.cn: 那间屋子天花板很低，墙是暖黄色。
ex.note: price ceiling 价格上限；hit the ceiling 大发雷霆

ex.en: The shop charged ten yuan for a bowl of noodles.
ex.cn: 那家店一碗面收十元钱。
ex.note: charge sb. for sth. 为某事向某人收费；charge a battery 给电池充电

ex.en: There is no charge for the first hour of parking.
ex.cn: 停车第一个小时不收费。
ex.note: free of charge 免费；in charge of 掌管；a serious charge 严重的指控

ex.en: He bought a bar of chocolate and two sticks of mint candy.
ex.cn: 他买了一块巧克力和两根薄荷糖。
ex.note: a bar of chocolate 一块巧克力；hot chocolate 热巧克力

ex.en: The crab raised one claw as if it were waving hello.
ex.cn: 那只螃蟹举起一只钳子，像在挥手问好。
ex.note: a crab's claw 蟹钳；cat's claw 猫爪

ex.en: He connected a coil of wire to the battery.
ex.cn: 他把一卷导线接到了电池上。
ex.note: a coil of wire 一卷导线；electric coil 线圈

ex.en: The sailor coiled the rope neatly on the deck.
ex.cn: 水手把缆绳整齐地盘在甲板上。
ex.note: coil sth. around sth. 把…盘绕在…上

ex.en: A committee of local residents was set up to repair the roofs.
ex.cn: 当地居民组成了一个委员会来修那些屋顶。
ex.note: a committee of … 由…组成的委员会；committee members 委员会成员

ex.en: The machine compresses the air inside the glass tube.
ex.cn: 这台机器压缩玻璃管里的空气。
ex.note: compress air 压缩空气；compress a speech 精简发言

ex.en: Students often confuse these two words in the exam.
ex.cn: 考试中学生常把这两个词弄混。
ex.note: confuse A with B 混淆 A 和 B；be confused about 对…感到困惑

ex.en: Every consumer wants a fair price and honest goods.
ex.cn: 每一位消费者都想要公道的价格和诚实的商品。
ex.note: consumer rights 消费者权益；consumer goods 消费品

ex.en: The evening breeze was cool after such a hot day.
ex.cn: 热了一整天之后，傍晚的风很凉爽。
ex.note: cool clothes 凉爽的衣服；a cool head 冷静的头脑

ex.en: Let the tea cool for five minutes before you drink it.
ex.cn: 让茶凉五分钟再喝。
ex.note: cool down 冷却；冷静下来

ex.en: The city has spread far out into the countryside.
ex.cn: 这座城市已经远远蔓延到乡下去了。
ex.note: in the countryside 在乡下；rural countryside 农村地区

ex.en: A critic might call the film dull, but the audience loved it.
ex.cn: 评论家或许会说这部电影乏味，可观众很爱看。
ex.note: film critic 影评人；the critics 批评界

ex.en: A heavy curtain hung behind the stage and hid the old walls.
ex.cn: 舞台后垂着一幅厚重的帷幕，遮住了旧墙。
ex.note: draw the curtain 拉上帷幕；curtain up 开演

ex.en: The heat in that small room was deadly by the afternoon.
ex.cn: 到了下午，那间小屋里的热度足以致命。
ex.note: deadly silence 死一般的寂静；deadly serious 极其严肃

ex.en: The lawyer prepared a careful defense for the young driver.
ex.cn: 律师为那名年轻司机准备了一份周密的辩护词。
ex.note: in self-defense 自卫；a defense against … 对…的辩护

ex.en: The deputy from the local office came to settle the argument.
ex.cn: 当地办事处那位副手赶来调解争端。
ex.note: deputy head 副手；deputy for sb. 代表某人

ex.en: The wall diagram showed how the machine was put together.
ex.cn: 墙上的图表画出了这台机器的组装方式。
ex.note: a diagram of … …的示意图；draw a diagram 画图表

ex.en: The old boots were covered with dirt from the field.
ex.cn: 那双旧靴子上沾满了田里的泥土。
ex.note: be covered in dirt 满是污垢；dirt on the wall 墙上的污痕

ex.en: A small dispute broke out between a tourist and a shopkeeper.
ex.cn: 一个游客和店主之间起了一场小小的争执。
ex.note: a dispute over/about … 关于…的争执

ex.en: Several students disputed the figures in the report.
ex.cn: 几个学生对报告里的数字提出了质疑。
ex.note: dispute sb.'s claim 对某人的说法提出异议

ex.en: By evening the moon dominated the whole sky.
ex.cn: 到了晚上，月亮主宰了整片天空。
ex.note: dominate a market 主导市场；be dominated by 被…支配

ex.en: People here drink tea at every hour of the day.
ex.cn: 这里的人一天到晚都在喝茶。
ex.note: drink sth. up 喝光；drink in 细品

ex.en: A hot drink is the best remedy for a cold evening.
ex.cn: 一杯热饮是寒冷傍晚最好的慰藉。
ex.note: soft drink 软饮料；a strong drink 一杯烈酒

ex.en: He earns enough to support the whole family.
ex.cn: 他挣的钱够养一家人。
ex.note: earn a living 谋生；earn a reputation 赢得声誉

ex.en: Eighteen guests came to the small ceremony in the church.
ex.cn: 十八位客人来参加了教堂里那场小小的仪式。
ex.note: eighteen years old 十八岁；a boy of eighteen 一个十八岁的男孩

ex.en: The coil began to emit a low hum as the current ran through it.
ex.cn: 电流通过时，线圈开始发出低低的嗡鸣。
ex.note: emit light/smell 发出光/气味；emit a sound 发出声音

ex.en: The mall has an enormous glass roof over its central hall.
ex.cn: 这座商场的中庭上覆盖着一座巨大的玻璃顶。
ex.note: an enormous amount of 大量的；an enormous appetite 巨大的胃口

ex.en: The old typist had established her business there forty years earlier.
ex.cn: 那位老打字员四十年前就在那里开了这个铺子。
ex.note: establish a business 创办企业；establish that … 证实…

ex.en: The bakery is small, but the bread is excellent.
ex.cn: 那家面包店很小，可面包极好。
ex.note: an excellent record 优异的成绩；excellent at 擅长

ex.en: Her explanation of the rules was clear and short.
ex.cn: 她对规则的解释清楚又简短。
ex.note: an explanation of/for … 对…的解释；by way of explanation 作为解释

ex.en: A faint smell of smoke came from somewhere down the street.
ex.cn: 街的什么地方飘来一股淡淡的烟味。
ex.note: a faint sound 微弱的声音；feel faint 感到头晕

ex.en: The groom was so nervous that he nearly fainted.
ex.cn: 新郎紧张得差点晕过去。
ex.note: faint from shock 惊吓晕厥；fall into a faint 昏倒

ex.en: Nobody knows what fate has in store for a young graduate.
ex.cn: 谁也不知道命运为一个应届毕业生准备了什么。
ex.note: seal one's fate 决定命运；a change of fate 命运的变化

ex.en: The doctor advised him to eat more fruit with plenty of fiber.
ex.cn: 医生建议他多吃富含纤维的水果。
ex.note: muscle fiber 肌肉纤维；fiber-rich food 富含纤维的食物

ex.en: The landlord promised to fix the leak in the ceiling.
ex.cn: 房东答应修好天花板上的漏口。
ex.note: fix a date 确定日期；fix sb. up 修整某人

ex.en: The market was full of fresh food from the surrounding farms.
ex.cn: 市场里摆满了周边农场出产的新鲜食品。
ex.note: canned food 罐头食品；a food of … …的一大类

ex.en: He stepped forward and offered his seat to her.
ex.cn: 他向前挪了一步，把座位让给了她。
ex.note: forward of 在…前面；put forward 提出

ex.en: Passengers must not put heavy bags in the forward section of the bus.
ex.cn: 乘客不得把重包放在巴士前部。
ex.note: in the forward part 在前部；forward-looking 有前瞻性的

ex.en: Please forward this letter to the manager's office.
ex.cn: 请把这封信转寄到经理办公室。
ex.note: forward sth. to sb. 把某物转交给某人

ex.en: The afternoon in the museum was more fruitful than any lecture.
ex.cn: 在博物馆里的那个下午比任何一堂课都更有收获。
ex.note: fruitful discussion 富有成效的讨论；a fruitful year 收获颇丰的一年

ex.en: Old garments were being sold at half price outside the market.
ex.cn: 市场外面正在半价出售旧衣服。
ex.note: the garment industry 制衣业；a woolen garment 一件毛制品

ex.en: He caught a glimpse of the sea through a gap in the clouds.
ex.cn: 透过云缝，他瞥见了大海。
ex.note: a glimpse of … …的一瞥；catch a glimpse of 瞥见

ex.en: From the top of the hill she glimpsed the whole valley below.
ex.cn: 从山顶上，她瞥见了下面整条山谷。
ex.note: glimpse sb./sth. 瞥见某人或某物

ex.en: The change from daylight to darkness was slow and gradual.
ex.cn: 从白昼到黑暗的变化缓慢而渐进。
ex.note: a gradual increase 逐渐增加；gradual progress 逐步进展

ex.en: The gross weight of the parcel was nearly two kilos.
ex.cn: 这个包裹的毛重将近两公斤。
ex.note: gross income 总收入；gross profit 毛利

ex.en: She pressed a handkerchief to her eyes and tried to smile.
ex.cn: 她把一方手帕按在眼睛上，努力想笑一笑。
ex.note: a silk handkerchief 一方丝帕；a pocket handkerchief 一方口袋巾

ex.en: The retired headmaster often wrote to his former students.
ex.cn: 那位退休的老校长常常给昔日的学生写信。
ex.note: the headmaster of a primary school 小学校长

ex.en: The old woman looked at herself in the cracked mirror.
ex.cn: 那老妇人对着裂了纹的镜子看了看自己。
ex.note: by herself 独自地；help yourself 随便吃

ex.en: The bakery sells a jar of honey from bees of its own.
ex.cn: 那家面包店卖着自己蜂场产的蜂蜜。
ex.note: honey 亲爱的（称呼语）；as sweet as honey 像蜜一样甜

ex.en: Her dry humour kept the whole class laughing.
ex.cn: 她那种不动声色的幽默逗得全班大笑。
ex.note: a sense of humour 幽默感；in a humorous mood 心情诙谐

ex.en: A large image of the old harbour hung on the wall.
ex.cn: 墙上挂着一幅老港的大幅图像。
ex.note: the image of … …的形象；an image of 一幅图像

ex.en: The price includes breakfast and a cup of coffee.
ex.cn: 价格包含早餐和一杯咖啡。
ex.note: be included in 包含在…之内；including … 包含…

ex.en: Mix all the ingredients in a large bowl before baking.
ex.cn: 烘烤前把所有原料在大碗里拌匀。
ex.note: a key ingredient 关键要素；ingredients for a dish 做一道菜的原料

ex.en: The teacher gave clear instructions before the experiment began.
ex.cn: 实验开始前，老师给出了清晰的说明。
ex.note: follow the instructions 遵照说明；instructions for … …的指示

ex.en: Tourists seem to invade the old town every weekend.
ex.cn: 游客们似乎每个周末都会涌入老城。
ex.note: invade sb.'s rights 侵犯某人的权利；be invaded by 被…入侵

ex.en: She bought a small silver ring at the jewelry shop.
ex.cn: 她在珠宝店买了一枚小银戒指。
ex.note: a piece of jewelry 一件首饰；a jewelry box 首饰盒

ex.en: They killed time waiting for the train with a game of cards.
ex.cn: 等火车的时候，他们打牌来消磨时间。
ex.note: kill time 消磨时间；kill a story 扼杀一个念头

ex.en: The lake and the hills together make a fine landscape.
ex.cn: 湖与群山构成一幅好风景。
ex.note: rural landscape 乡村风景；a landscape of … …的全景

ex.en: Water was leaking from a pipe in the ceiling.
ex.cn: 天花板上的管子在漏水。
ex.note: leak information 泄露消息；a gas leak 煤气泄漏

ex.en: He hung his license in a frame beside the door.
ex.cn: 他把执照装进镜框挂在门边。
ex.note: a driving license 驾照；apply for a license 申请执照

ex.en: The city licensed two new shops in the old market.
ex.cn: 市里给老市场新开的两家店铺发了执照。
ex.note: license sb. to do sth. 许可某人做某事

ex.en: The old town is a living museum of the nineteenth century.
ex.cn: 这座老城是一座活生生的十九世纪博物馆。
ex.note: a living language 活的语言；living things 生物

ex.en: He works two jobs to make a living for the family.
ex.cn: 他打两份工来养家糊口。
ex.note: earn/make a living 谋生；a living wage 维持生活的工资

ex.en: The shop was empty and the prices were lower than in the market.
ex.cn: 店里没什么人，价格也比市场里低。
ex.note: lower than 低于；a lower price 更低的价格

ex.en: Please lower the volume; I can hardly hear you.
ex.cn: 请把音量调低一点，我几乎听不见你说话。
ex.note: lower the price 降价；lower oneself 屈尊

ex.en: A new mall with a huge glass roof stands near the station.
ex.cn: 车站附近新立起一座顶着巨大玻璃屋顶的商场。
ex.note: shopping mall 购物中心；a pedestrian mall 步行商业街

ex.en: She seems very mature for a girl of seventeen.
ex.cn: 对一个十七岁的女孩来说，她显得很成熟。
ex.note: mature enough to do 成熟到足以做；mature for one's age 年龄上早熟

ex.en: These young trees will mature in about ten years.
ex.cn: 这些小树大约十年就能长成。
ex.note: mature into 成熟为；mature off 成熟后采摘

ex.en: Her mental health improved after a year in the countryside.
ex.cn: 在乡下住了一年之后，她的精神好多了。
ex.note: mental health 心理健康；mental stress 精神压力

ex.en: She became a minister of education in her thirties.
ex.cn: 她三十几岁时成了教育部长。
ex.note: a government minister 政府部长；the minister 牧师

ex.en: The monitor in the corner showed the time in green digits.
ex.cn: 角落里的显示器用绿色数字显示着时间。
ex.note: monitor screen 显示屏；class monitor 班长

ex.en: Nurses monitor the patient's heart rate every hour.
ex.cn: 护士每小时监测一次病人的心率。
ex.note: monitor progress 监控进展；monitor against 防范

ex.en: He ordered a mug of tea and a bowl of soup.
ex.cn: 他点了一大杯茶和一碗汤。
ex.note: a mug of 一大杯（茶或咖啡）

ex.en: We rented a small flat near the campus gate.
ex.cn: 我们在校门附近租了一间小公寓。
ex.note: near to 接近；in the near future 在不久的将来

ex.en: Winter is nearing, and the days are getting shorter.
ex.cn: 冬天快到了，白天越来越短。
ex.note: draw near 临近；near the end of 在…的末尾附近

ex.en: They spent a nice evening walking by the harbour.
ex.cn: 他们在港口边散步，度过了一个愉快的夜晚。
ex.note: nice and + adj. 十分…；It is nice to do sth. 做某事真好

ex.en: The difference between the two hotels is hardly noticeable.
ex.cn: 这两家酒店的区别几乎察觉不到。
ex.note: barely noticeable 几乎察觉不到；a noticeable difference 明显的差别

ex.en: He pays the occasional visit to the old market.
ex.cn: 他偶尔会去老市场走走。
ex.note: an occasional visitor 偶尔来访者；on occasional occasions 偶尔

ex.en: Please open the window; the room feels stuffy.
ex.cn: 请把窗户打开，屋里闷得很。
ex.note: open the door 开门；open a shop 开店

ex.en: He was very open about his plans for the future.
ex.cn: 他对自己的未来计划毫不隐瞒。
ex.note: be open to 对…持开放态度；an open question 未决的问题

ex.en: You ought to see a doctor if the pain continues.
ex.cn: 如果疼痛持续，你该去看医生。
ex.note: ought to do 应该做；ought to have done 本该做而未做

ex.en: The sign on the door records the ownership of the shop.
ex.cn: 门上的牌子记载着这家店铺的所有权。
ex.note: home ownership 房屋所有权；take ownership of 承担…的责任

ex.en: We took a bus to the park and walked around the lake.
ex.cn: 我们坐公交去了公园，绕着湖走了一圈。
ex.note: park entrance 公园入口；car park 停车场

ex.en: You cannot park here without a permit.
ex.cn: 没有许可证不能在这里停车。
ex.note: park the car 停车；double parking 违章并排停车

ex.en: She picked the last peas out of the bowl.
ex.cn: 她把碗里最后几粒豌豆夹走了。
ex.note: green peas 青豌豆；as like as two peas 一模一样

ex.en: If the symptoms persist, you should see a doctor.
ex.cn: 如果症状持续，你应该去看医生。
ex.note: persist in doing 坚持做；persist despite 尽管如此仍持续

ex.en: Pigeons gathered on the steps of the old church.
ex.cn: 鸽子聚集在老教堂的台阶上。
ex.note: pigeonhole 分类架；a pigeon fan 鸽迷

ex.en: We have plenty of time before the train leaves.
ex.cn: 离火车开车还有大把时间。
ex.note: plenty of 大量的；plenty of time 有充足的时间

ex.en: The old market has grown in popularity over the past ten years.
ex.cn: 老市场在过去十年里越来越受欢迎。
ex.note: gain/win popularity 赢得人气；the popularity of … …的流行

ex.en: A powerful engine lifted the boat over the waves.
ex.cn: 一台强劲的引擎把船托出浪尖。
ex.note: a powerful voice 有力的嗓音；powerful medicine 强效药

ex.en: In the previous chapter we met a young engineer from the coast.
ex.cn: 上一章我们认识了一位来自海边的年轻工程师。
ex.note: previous to 在…之前；on the previous day 在前一天

ex.en: Teaching is the profession he chose for life.
ex.cn: 教书是他选定终身的职业。
ex.note: enter a profession 进入某行业；the medical profession 医务界

ex.en: You may take the book, provided you return it next week.
ex.cn: 你可以把书带走，条件是下周还回来。
ex.note: provided (that) 假如；用作条件连词，引导状语从句

ex.en: The quantity of rice in the bag is not enough for ten people.
ex.cn: 袋里的米不够十个人吃。
ex.note: a large quantity of 大量的（不可数）；a quantity of 一些

ex.en: He rarely eats meat; he prefers vegetables and fish.
ex.cn: 他很少吃肉，更喜欢蔬菜和鱼。
ex.note: rarely 置于句首时句子要部分倒装；rarely ever 极少

ex.en: The hotel offers a banquet hall for wedding receptions.
ex.cn: 这家酒店有一间可以举办婚宴的宴会厅。
ex.note: a wedding reception 婚宴；reception desk 前台

ex.en: Please register your name and address at the desk.
ex.cn: 请在前台登记您的姓名和地址。
ex.note: register for 报名参加；register a letter 挂号寄信

ex.en: The hotel keeps a register of all its guests.
ex.cn: 旅馆有一本登记所有客人的簿子。
ex.note: in the register 在登记簿上；a car's register 车的登记证

ex.en: He removed his hat and hung it on the hook.
ex.cn: 他摘下帽子挂在钩子上。
ex.note: remove sth. from 从…移开；remove one's shoes 脱鞋

ex.en: They resolved to leave early so as to avoid the traffic.
ex.cn: 他们决定早点出发，避开交通高峰。
ex.note: resolve to do 决心做；resolve a dispute 解决争端

ex.en: He made a resolve to study harder in the new term.
ex.cn: 他下定决心在新学期里更用功。
ex.note: a resolve to do 做成某事的决心；with resolve 坚决地

ex.en: A bowl of rice and some vegetables make a simple dinner.
ex.cn: 一碗米饭配上几样蔬菜，就是一顿简单的晚饭。
ex.note: a bowl of rice 一碗米饭；rice paddy 稻田

ex.en: He picked a yellow rose from the garden and gave it to his sister.
ex.cn: 他从花园里摘了一朵黄玫瑰送给妹妹。
ex.note: a rose garden 玫瑰园；a rose of … 一朵…的玫瑰

ex.en: The village church was named after a saint long ago.
ex.cn: 这座乡村教堂很久以前就是以一位圣人的名字命名的。
ex.note: St. Peter 圣彼得；act like a saint 做得像圣人一样

ex.en: She wound a long woollen scarf around her neck.
ex.cn: 她把一条长长的毛围巾在脖子上绕了一圈。
ex.note: a silk scarf 一条丝巾；scarf down 围上围巾

ex.en: He kept it a secret from his family for years.
ex.cn: 这件事他瞒着家里人好多年。
ex.note: keep sth. a secret 保守秘密；in secret 秘密地

ex.en: The old town has a secret charm that photos never show.
ex.cn: 老城有一种照片永远拍不出来的隐秘魅力。
ex.note: secret passage 秘密通道；a secret admirer 暗恋者

ex.en: A good employer treats every servant with respect.
ex.cn: 好雇主尊重每一个雇员。
ex.note: a public servant 公务员；a servant of … 做…的仆人

ex.en: The child picked up a pink shell on the beach.
ex.cn: 孩子在沙滩上捡起一枚粉色的贝壳。
ex.note: a shell of a building 建筑外壳；shellfish 贝类

ex.en: The city offers guided sightseeing tours every morning.
ex.cn: 这座城市每天上午都有带讲解的观光团。
ex.note: go sightseeing 去观光；a sightseeing tour 观光团

ex.en: This coat is the wrong size; I need a larger one.
ex.cn: 这件外套的尺码不对，我要大一号。
ex.note: the size of … …的大小；try on for size 试穿看尺码是否合适

ex.en: The table top was smooth and cold to the touch.
ex.cn: 桌面光滑，触手冰凉。
ex.note: smooth skin 光滑的皮肤；a smooth surface 光滑的表面

ex.en: She smoothed the tablecloth with both hands.
ex.cn: 她用双手把桌布抚平。
ex.note: smooth sth. out 把…抚平；smooth over 掩盖过去

ex.en: I will visit that old library sometime next month.
ex.cn: 下个月某个时候我要去看看那座旧图书馆。
ex.note: sometime next week 下周某个时候；sometime or other 迟早

ex.en: After the wedding she specialized in writing about small towns.
ex.cn: 婚后她专门写小镇题材。
ex.note: specialize in 专攻；specialize in doing 专门从事

ex.en: Each spouse filled in the form and signed it.
ex.cn: 夫妻双方各自填了表并签了字。
ex.note: husband or spouse 丈夫或配偶；a spouse of … …的配偶

ex.en: The steak was thick, rare and rather expensive.
ex.cn: 那份牛排很厚，三分熟，而且相当贵。
ex.note: beef steak 牛排；steak house 牛排馆

ex.en: Never tell a stranger about your bank details.
ex.cn: 绝不要把银行账户信息告诉陌生人。
ex.note: a complete stranger 完全陌生的人；be a stranger to 对…是陌生的

ex.en: The old bridge is substantial enough to carry heavy trucks.
ex.cn: 那座旧桥足够结实，能承载重型卡车。
ex.note: a substantial amount of 大量的；a substantial meal 丰盛的一餐

ex.en: We sat on the old wall and waited for the sunset.
ex.cn: 我们坐在旧墙上等日落。
ex.note: at sunset 日落时分；before sunset 日落之前

ex.en: A bead of sweat ran down his temple.
ex.cn: 一滴汗顺着他的太阳穴淌下来。
ex.note: break into a sweat 出汗；a sweat shirt 汗衫

ex.en: He sweated heavily during the final game.
ex.cn: 最后一场比赛他出了很多汗。
ex.note: sweat over 为…操心；sweat one's butt 拼命努力

ex.en: Our target is to finish the report before Friday.
ex.cn: 我们的目标是在周五之前完成报告。
ex.note: hit the target 命中靶心；meet a target 达到目标

ex.en: The company is targeting a wider market in the countryside.
ex.cn: 公司正瞄准更广阔的乡村市场。
ex.note: be targeted at/for 以…为目标

ex.en: They played tennis on the cracked court until the light went.
ex.cn: 他们在龟裂的球场上打网球，直到天色暗下来。
ex.note: play tennis 打网球；a tennis court 网球场

ex.en: The thermometer on the wall showed minus ten degrees.
ex.cn: 墙上的温度计显示零下十度。
ex.note: a clinical thermometer 体温计；the mercury column 温度计的水银柱

ex.en: She turned the page with her thumb.
ex.cn: 她用拇指翻过一页。
ex.note: thumb nail 拇指甲；all thumbs 笨手笨脚

ex.en: He showed great tolerance of other people's mistakes.
ex.cn: 他对别人的错误表现出极大的宽容。
ex.note: tolerance for … 对…的容忍；a tolerance of 一点（量）

ex.en: The evening traffic was so heavy that the bus barely moved.
ex.cn: 傍晚的交通堵得厉害，巴士几乎不动。
ex.note: traffic jam 交通堵塞；heavy traffic 交通繁忙

ex.en: The company trimmed its costs to survive the winter.
ex.cn: 公司削减成本以熬过冬天。
ex.note: trim costs 削减成本；trimmed with 以…装饰

ex.en: Her short hair was neat and trim.
ex.cn: 她的短发整洁又利落。
ex.note: a trim figure 苗条的身材；trim and neat 整洁

ex.en: The old typist still writes letters for people every morning.
ex.cn: 那位老打字员每天早晨仍替人写信。
ex.note: a copy typist 誊写员；a typist pool 打字员办公室

ex.en: She is studying engineering at a university far from home.
ex.cn: 她在一所离家很远的大学读工程学。
ex.note: enter university 进大学；a university student 大学生

ex.en: The summer vacation begins in early July and lasts two months.
ex.cn: 暑假从七月初开始，持续两个月。
ex.note: summer/winter vacation 寒暑假；on vacation 在度假

ex.en: From the top of the hill there is a fine view of the whole bay.
ex.cn: 从山顶上可以望见整个海湾的美景。
ex.note: a view of … …的景色；in one's view 在某人看来

ex.en: She views the city differently now than she did a year ago.
ex.cn: 现在她看待这座城市的方式与一年前不同了。
ex.note: view sth. as 把某物看作

ex.en: Volunteers are needed to help at the registration desk.
ex.cn: 登记台需要人手帮忙，招募志愿者。
ex.note: a volunteer worker 志愿工作者；volunteer work 志愿工作

ex.en: She volunteered to look after the children that afternoon.
ex.cn: 那个下午她自告奋勇照看孩子。
ex.note: volunteer to do 自愿做；volunteer for sth. 自愿参与某事

ex.en: Health is a kind of wealth that money cannot buy.
ex.cn: 健康是一种金钱买不到的财富。
ex.note: a wealth of 大量的；national wealth 国家财富

ex.en: When will the results come out?
ex.cn: 结果什么时候出来？
ex.note: when = at which time 什么时候；no matter when 无论何时

ex.en: A cold wind came in from the sea.
ex.cn: 一阵冷风从海上吹来。
ex.note: in the wind 在风中；the wind of change 变革之风

ex.en: The old road winds through the hills for ten miles.
ex.cn: 那条老路在山间蜿蜒了十英里。
ex.note: wind up 上发条；wind sth. around 把…缠绕在…上

ex.en: A worm crawls slowly out of the wet soil.
ex.cn: 一条虫子从湿土里慢慢爬了出来。
ex.note: earthworm 蚯蚓；a worm in the bud 隐患

ex.en: Did you remember to bring your camera with you?
ex.cn: 你记得把相机带来了吗？
ex.note: you and yours 你和你的一切；young you 年轻时的你
